cfg.language: Language for PushPug's notifications and screens.
cfg.theme.system: Follow the current VS Code theme (switches instantly with it)
cfg.interval: Seconds between checks while VS Code is open (10–300). PushPug also checks every time you switch back to VS Code.
cfg.notify.inVSCode: Show a pop-up inside VS Code when teammates push.
cfg.notify.desktop: Show a notification on your computer's screen when VS Code isn't focused.
cfg.notify.background: Keep checking even when VS Code is closed, every `#pushpug.background.intervalSeconds#`. PushPug installs a small background task on this computer (macOS LaunchAgent / Windows Task Scheduler) that only runs `git fetch` — it never pulls or changes your files. Turning this off removes the task.
cfg.notify.sameFile: Warn extra loudly when a teammate changed a file you are also changing.
cmd.switchMode: Switch Check Mode · เปลี่ยนโหมด
cfg.mode: How often PushPug checks. Picking a preset fills in every value below; editing any of them switches to **custom**.
cfg.mode.batterySaver: 🔋 Battery saver — every 60 s, slower when idle or on battery
cfg.background.interval: Seconds between checks while VS Code is closed (60–3600). Used only when `#pushpug.notify.background#` is on.
cfg.battery.idle.enabled: Slow down when the computer hasn't been used for a while.
cfg.battery.idle.minutes: Minutes without keyboard / mouse input before the idle rule applies (1–240).
cfg.battery.low.enabled: Slow down when the battery is low and the charger isn't plugged in.
cfg.battery.low.percent: Battery level (%) below which the low-battery rule applies (5–95).
cfg.battery.low.interval: Seconds between checks on low battery (10–3600).
cfg.battery.lpm.enabled: Slow down while macOS Low Power Mode / Windows Battery Saver / the Linux power-saver profile is on.
cfg.battery.lpm.interval: Seconds between checks in Low Power Mode (10–3600).
cfg.battery.plugged: Always use the normal interval while plugged in, whatever the rules above say.
cfg.hours.enabled: Only check between `#pushpug.activeHours.start#` and `#pushpug.activeHours.end#`; pause outside (also the background task).
cfg.hours.end: End of the checking hours (HH:MM, 24-hour). Can be earlier than the start for overnight hours.
cfg.actions.enabled: Report GitHub checks (Actions and other checks) for each commit: after your pushes and your teammates', in the status bar and in My Team. Uses VS Code's GitHub sign-in.
cfg.actions.interval: Seconds between GitHub Actions checks while a run is in progress (10–120). Without a GitHub sign-in, at most once a minute.
cfg.avatars: Show commit authors' GitHub profile pictures in My Team. Pictures load from GitHub (`avatars.githubusercontent.com`); for authors without a GitHub noreply address PushPug asks the GitHub API once per new upstream commit.
cmd.push: Push (Check First) · push แบบเช็กก่อน
cmd.undoMerge: Undo Last Merge · ย้อนการรวมเมื่อกี้
cmd.snooze: Mute Alerts for 1 Hour · ปิดเตือน 1 ชั่วโมง
cmd.unsnooze: Unmute Alerts · เปิดเตือน
cfg.actions.onPass: Also tell me when checks pass (failures are always reported).
cfg.actions.for: Whose pushes to report checks for.
cfg.quiet.enabled: Do not disturb between `#pushpug.quiet.start#` and `#pushpug.quiet.end#`: no pop-ups or desktop notifications (the status bar keeps updating).
cfg.quiet.end: End of the quiet hours (HH:MM). Can be earlier than the start for overnight.
